query: What patient-safety monitoring triggers and immediate outreach/escalation pathways will be implemented for responses indicating inability to take prophylaxis?

response.query: What patient-safety monitoring triggers and immediate outreach/escalation pathways will be implemented for responses indicating inability to take prophylaxis?
response.answer: Patient-safety monitoring triggers include immediate outreach and escalation for patients unable to take prophylaxis, with alerts and follow-up protocols in place. Rapid response teams will be activated, and care plans will be reviewed. Escalation pathways involve notifying senior medical staff and possibly involving emergency services.

This proposed rule would revise the Medicare Advantage (Part C), Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit (Part D), Medicare cost plan, and Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) regulations to implement changes related to Star Ratings, marketing and communications, agent/broker compensation, health equity, dual eligible special needs plans (D-SNPs), utilization management, network adequacy, and other programmatic areas.
